viewWelcome.0:
Open a C or C++ file to inspect the symbol under the cursor.
[Restart clangd](command:cInsight.restartClangd)
viewWelcome.1:
Open a C or C++ file to inspect the symbol under the cursor.
[Open Project Diagnostics](command:cInsight.openProjectDiagnostics)
viewWelcome.4: Place the cursor in a C/C++ file, then [show its include hierarchy](command:cInsight.includeHierarchy.showIncludes).
viewWelcome.5: Place the cursor in a C/C++ file, then [find files that include it](command:cInsight.includeHierarchy.showIncludedBy).
configuration.cInsight.engine.descriptio: Semantic analysis engine. Changing this setting requires Reload Window.
configuration.cInsight.engine.enumDescri: Start and manage C Insight's bundled clangd client.
Use the installed Microsoft C/C++ extension through public VS Code Provider commands.
configuration.cInsight.microsoft.callers: Callers implementation used by the Microsoft C/C++ engine. clangd mode is unaffected.
Build approximate Callers from References and enclosing Document Symbols; avoids the cpptools native Incoming Calls path.
Use the cpptools native Incoming Calls Provider. This may crash some cpptools versions for cross-file symbols.
Disable Callers expansion in Microsoft engine mode.
configuration.cInsight.clangd.path.descr: Path to the clangd executable. Empty uses PATH.
configuration.cInsight.compileCommandsDi: Directory containing compile_commands.json. Empty automatically searches the workspace root and common build directories.
configuration.cInsight.diagnostics.repor: Redact filesystem paths, or paths plus macro definitions/fallback flags, from copied and exported Project Diagnostics reports.
configuration.cInsight.followCursorDetai: Additional idle delay before loading references and first-level caller/callee counts.
configuration.cInsight.navigation.double: Maximum interval in milliseconds between two activations of the same source-location tree result for opening it in the editor.
configuration.cInsight.codePreview.lines: Number of source lines displayed before the Code Preview target.
Number of source lines displayed after the Code Preview target.
configuration.cInsight.codePreview.seman: Use the active VS Code semantic token provider to color symbols in Code Preview, with lexical highlighting as a fallback.
Maximum milliseconds Code Preview waits for semantic tokens before rendering immediately with lexical highlighting.
Maximum number of document-version semantic-token results retained in memory.
Approximate maximum total memory in MiB retained by completed Code Preview semantic-token cache entries.
configuration.cInsight.codePreview.incre: Load more source context when Code Preview is scrolled near its top or bottom edge.
configuration.cInsight.codePreview.loadB: Number of source lines added for each incremental Code Preview load.
configuration.cInsight.codePreview.maxim: Maximum source lines retained in the Code Preview DOM; distant lines are trimmed and can be loaded again.
configuration.cInsight.codePreview.resto: Restore loaded context and vertical/horizontal scroll position when returning to a previous Code Preview target.
configuration.cInsight.codePreview.maxim: Maximum Code Preview target scroll positions retained for the current extension session.
configuration.cInsight.analysis.maximumC: Maximum number of semantic-engine requests that C Insight may run concurrently. Interactive requests are dequeued before normal and background work.
configuration.cInsight.analysis.maximumB: Maximum concurrent background-detail requests within the total semantic request limit.
configuration.cInsight.analysis.slowRequ: Duration in milliseconds after which a completed or failed semantic-engine request is counted and logged as slow.
configuration.cInsight.references.pageSi: Number of reference results added to the tree per page.
configuration.cInsight.references.maximu: Maximum number of reference result tree nodes displayed at once, including Show All. Filtering and exports still operate on the full result set within their own limits.
configuration.cInsight.references.detail: Maximum per-kind LRU entries retained for References Document Highlight and Signature Help detail requests.
configuration.cInsight.export.maximumRes: Maximum number of records included in one References export. Results beyond the limit are omitted and reported in export metadata.
configuration.cInsight.export.maximumMeg: Maximum encoded size in MiB for References, Call, Type, or Include hierarchy exports. Oversized output is not written.
configuration.cInsight.references.groupB: Persisted grouping mode for the References view.
configuration.cInsight.history.maximumEn: Maximum number of navigation history entries retained for the current VS Code session.
configuration.cInsight.history.mergeCons: Merge consecutive navigation entries with the same location, mode, and origin.
configuration.cInsight.symbolSearch.grou: Persisted grouping mode for the Symbol Search view.
Persisted sorting mode for bookmarks within each group.
configuration.cInsight.session.restore.d: Automatically save and restore C Insight browsing state for the current folder or multi-root workspace.
configuration.cInsight.session.persistNa: Include Navigation History in the workspace session snapshot.
configuration.cInsight.session.restoreCa: Re-query and restore the previous Callers/Callees root and loaded depth.
configuration.cInsight.session.restoreRe: Restore a Relationship Graph that was still open when VS Code exited, as a static snapshot without issuing semantic or include queries.
configuration.cInsight.session.relations: Maximum Relationship Graph nodes stored in a workspace session; larger graphs degrade to a root-only snapshot.
configuration.cInsight.session.maximumSn: Maximum serialized workspace-session size in KiB; oversized snapshots progressively drop graph and older/secondary navigation state.
configuration.cInsight.session.maximumAg: Ignore saved workspace sessions older than this many days.
configuration.cInsight.typeHierarchy.def: Type hierarchy depth loaded automatically for a new root. Zero keeps roots collapsed.
configuration.cInsight.typeHierarchy.max: Maximum depth allowed for type hierarchy expansion.
Maximum number of nodes loaded independently in each Supertypes or Subtypes tree.
Include hierarchy depth loaded automatically for a new root. Zero keeps roots collapsed.
Maximum depth allowed for include hierarchy expansion.
Maximum number of include hierarchy nodes loaded for the current root.
Resolve and expand system headers in include hierarchies. Disabled by default to avoid very large trees.
Maximum workspace source/header files scanned when building the on-demand Included By index.
configuration.cInsight.relationshipGraph: Whether a new function or type graph root loads its first relationship level. Zero keeps only the root.
Maximum relationship depth allowed in the graph.
Maximum semantic nodes retained in the current relationship graph.
Maximum semantic edges retained in the current relationship graph.
Allow system headers to enter the relationship graph when Include adapters are enabled.
configuration.cInsight.symbolSearch.maxi: Maximum workspace symbol results displayed per query.
configuration.cInsight.symbolSearch.debo: Delay in milliseconds before sending a workspace symbol query while typing.
configuration.cInsight.callHierarchy.def: Call hierarchy depth expanded automatically for a new root. Zero keeps roots collapsed.
configuration.cInsight.callHierarchy.max: Maximum depth allowed for manual or automatic call hierarchy expansion.
Maximum number of nodes created independently in each Callers or Callees tree.
configuration.cInsight.callHierarchy.pat: Maximum edge depth explored by caller/callee path search.
Maximum matching call paths returned by one search.
Maximum semantic nodes visited by one call path search.
configuration.cInsight.exclude.descripti: Path fragments excluded from C Insight result views.
